podcast.title: Signature Skateboards
podcast.body: At least three custom JFA signature skateboards were produced, further cementing their iconic status within the skateboarding community. "And there are at least three custom JFA signature skateboards."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Skateboard Compilation Presence
podcast.body: JFA appeared on nearly every skateboard-related punk rock compilation throughout the 1980s. These compilations bore titles such as "Blazing Wheels and Marking Trucks," "Born to Skate," "Concrete Waves," and "Explicit Skate Rock." "JFA appeared on just about every skateboard related punk rock compilation in the 1980s."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Skateboard Film Soundtracks
podcast.body: At least a dozen soundtracks for skateboard films featured material from JFA. "I know of at least a dozen soundtracks to skateboard films that feature JFA material."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Tony Hawk's Recognition
podcast.body: Pro-skater Tony Hawk was familiar with JFA, leading to the inclusion of their music in his popular skateboard video games. "Tony Hawk knew all about JFA, which is why you'll find JFA music in his skateboard video games."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
